text: {"summary":"Ratan Tata said he feels lonely and is going through a painful time amid the public dispute with Cyrus Mistry, which he said involved attacks on his and the Tata Group’s reputation. He thanked shareholders for their support and said he believed the truth would prevail."}

{ "summary": "CBS canceled its new comedy “We Are Men” after two episodes, following low ratings. “2 Broke Girls” will move into its Monday time slot, and “Mike & Molly” will return to the schedule on November 4." }

{"summary":"About 40 people were burned during a firewalking exercise at a Tony Robbins seminar in Dallas, likely because some participants lingered on the hot coals while taking selfies or being photographed. Firewalking can be done safely when the coals are properly prepared and people keep moving at a steady pace."}

{"summary":"The writer switched from a Galaxy S7 to an iPhone 6s Plus because the iPhone lasts much longer on a charge. Despite the S7’s superior camera, design, water resistance, and Android features, it often died by 5 p.m. under the writer’s heavy use."}

{ "summary": "Fashion designer Charlotte Ronson’s New York home is airy and comfortable, with white walls, eclectic art, baby-blue dining chairs, and fresh flowers adding bright pops of color. Ronson says having art and beautiful things around her makes a real difference." }

{"summary":"The article recommends 11 films from 2016 streaming on Netflix—among them *The Jungle Book*, *Barry*, *Zootopia* and *The Invitation*—plus *Whiskey Tango Foxtrot* on Hulu. The post is teasing this list of 12 movies, including Obama’s college-years biopic, a tense dinner-party thriller and Disney favorites."}

{ "summary": "Scientists worry that Finding Dory could spark a surge in demand for blue tangs as pets, as Finding Nemo did for clownfish. Blue tangs are rarer, fare poorly in tanks, and are collected in regions with few protections, so increased capture could damage marine ecosystems; the article urges viewers to leave them in the ocean." }

{"summary":"The article recommends 29 impactful pieces of writing published in 2016 by women, covering subjects including sexual violence, racism, abortion, politics, and identity. It highlights work by writers such as Roxane Gay, Rebecca Traister, and Masha Gessen, and argues that women’s voices and quality journalism matter especially in a difficult political moment."}

{"summary":"Spark was New Zealand’s most complained-about company in the Commerce Commission’s 2016 report, receiving 140 complaints, ahead of Vodafone (133) and Trade Me sellers (121). Pricing was the most common complaint, and the Commission cautioned that complaints did not necessarily mean a company had broken the law."}

{ "summary": "ScHoolboy Q said he nearly quit rap after his album Oxymoron because years away from home meant he had missed much of his daughter’s childhood. He didn’t want to prioritize his career and money over raising his family." }

{"summary":"The post is teasing a roundup of 19 teens who went above and beyond in 2016, including a Mulan-inspired school ID, an umbrella photo sent in response to a request for a shower pic, extravagant senior photos, a deer best friend, and a teen who found a dead body while playing Pokémon Go."}

{"summary":"The secret is a subtle gleam of light in human characters’ eyes: cinematographer Dean Cundey says he and John Carpenter used an “eye light” to hint who was still human. The post is teasing that this visual clue may help identify whether the two men left alive at the end are human."}
{"summary":"The food industry plans to make food labels easier to understand by replacing confusing wording with clearer language. The changes are expected to reach grocery stores soon."}

{"summary":"Bikers Bret and Zach Winingar found an emaciated puppy locked in a chewed-up crate during a ride in Little Rock, Arkansas. They rescued her, got her veterinary care, and adopted her; now healthy Charlie Bravo has inspired them to start a charity called C.B.’s Angels."}

{"summary":"An Arkansas man’s Roomba ran over his dog’s poop while he was asleep and smeared it across the house. The mishap illustrates the article’s point: household robots and smart appliances often add too little convenience, while struggling with the unpredictable clutter and layout of real homes."}

{"summary":"Amateur archaeologists uncovered a previously unrecorded passageway beneath Emperor Hadrian’s second-century villa in Tivoli, Italy. It connected the villa’s Academy area to a four-kilometer underground road in a vast network that likely let slaves, merchants, and carts move around unseen while keeping the estate running."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing bone broth as an unusual morning drink. Made by simmering bones with vegetables and herbs for 8–24 hours, it’s said to provide nutrients and may help with bone health, inflammation, digestion, skin, and immunity; fans drink it as a filling start to the day."}

{"summary":"The article says that contestants on NBC’s The Biggest Loser lost weight through extreme training—up to eight hours a day—but the results may have been only temporary, rather than a lasting transformation."}

{"summary":"Men are using period-tracking apps such as iAmAMan and uPMS to monitor their female colleagues’ and partners’ menstrual cycles, supposedly to avoid them when they have PMS. One woman said coworkers started tracking her cycle after an argument at work."}

{"summary":"The post teases a Rockstar announcement, but the article is explicitly satire and reports no real GTA 6 news. It jokes that the game will have improved graphics and physics, playable voiced protagonists, multiplayer, radio and mature content, while mocking leaks, delays, server problems, and costly in-game purchases."}

{"summary":"Whole Foods co-CEO Walter Robb says he won’t hire people who lack humility and excessively promote themselves. He recommends balancing confidence with openness to others’ ideas and giving coworkers credit."}

{"summary":"The article recommends 20 smartphone apps that encourage outdoor activities, including walking, cycling, wildlife spotting, stargazing, fishing, geocaching, camping and parkour. The post is teasing this list of apps for getting you out and about."}

{"summary":"The Battlefield 1 Open Beta ends Thursday, September 8. EA also removed time limits from Sinai Desert Conquest matches, announced server stress testing that could cause downtime, and said the full game launches worldwide October 21."}

{"summary":"Harvard’s decades-long study found that close, supportive relationships—not wealth, fame, or career success—are the key to happier, healthier lives. People with strong connections tend to stay healthier longer, while unwanted isolation is linked to earlier declines in health and brain function and shorter lives."}

{"summary":"The article highlights Tesla quirks and milestones: its Model S, Model X, Model 3, and planned Model Y spell “SEXY”; its cars hide rainbow-road, James Bond, and Mars Easter eggs; and the Model S broke a roof-crush test machine, became the first electric Motor Trend Car of the Year, and later reached a 315-mile range."}

{"summary":"Nine-year-old Molly Sings sings Kasey Chambers’ “Not Pretty Enough” in a tearjerking blind audition on The Voice Kids Australia, moving the judges and her proud family. Afterward, Mel B encourages Molly to choose her as coach, praising her control and confidence and appealing to their shared experience as girls."}
{"summary":"Lindsay Lohan is recording with Duran Duran, pictured in the studio with band members Simon Le Bon and Nick Rhodes alongside her younger sister, singer Ali Lohan."}

{"summary":"Although Elizabeth Warren repeatedly says she isn’t running for president, her memoir argues that she should keep fighting for working families wherever she can make the greatest difference—including, the article suggests, in the White House. It points to her past reluctance to take on major roles, which she ultimately accepted when she believed people needed her to fight."}

{"summary":"The tiny plastic tripod in the middle of a pizza is called a pizza saver. Invented by Carmela Vitale in the 1980s, it keeps a sagging pizza-box lid from touching the pizza and pulling off the cheese."}

{"summary":"LendLease sold all 391 apartments at its Darling Square development in Sydney in just four hours, with prices ranging from A$630,000 for a studio to A$3.5 million for a penthouse. The sellout suggests demand remains strong despite a large pipeline of new apartments due to be completed."}

{"summary":"The article predicts that within 15 years, the standard 9-to-5 workday will become the exception as flexible schedules and working from home become common. It cites millennials’ preference for flexibility, work-family balance and continued learning, reduced need for office space, and evidence that remote workers can be more productive."}
{"summary":"Research suggests people may come to resemble their names: in experiments, volunteers matched a person’s headshot to the correct name more often than chance."}

{"summary":"Alex Newell, who plays Wade “Unique” Adams on “Glee,” has joined the cast of *Geography Club*, a film adaptation of Brent Hartinger’s novel. Newell says the story appealed to them because it could help audiences better understand what transgender people go through."}

{ "summary": "The post’s “horrifying” #8 is KFC’s BBQ sandwich: a former employee claims it was made from chicken considered too old and stale for donation, softened in BBQ sauce, then kept on a warmer for weeks. The article also relays former workers’ warnings about items at chains including Panera, Taco Bell, Starbucks, McDonald’s, Wendy’s, and gas stations." }

{ "summary": "The article ranks the 10 worst seasons in New York sports history, from the 1972-73 Islanders to the 1983-88 Columbia football team, whose 44-game losing streak takes first place. The 2014-15 Knicks, then 5-36 and on a 16-game skid, rank second—behind Columbia but ahead of the 1962 Mets." }

{"summary":"After a study found that former “Biggest Loser” contestants’ metabolisms had slowed and most regained weight, host Bob Harper suggested intermittent fasting to help people maintain major weight loss. His own approach is to fast for 14 hours, usually by skipping breakfast, then eat two meals within a 10-hour window; experts say long-term benefits remain uncertain, and fasting is unsafe for some people."}

{"summary":"Drake’s album “Views” spent its ninth consecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, with streaming making up a significant share of its chart performance—the first album to sustain such a run since Billboard began counting streams in 2014. He also became the first male artist in more than 10 years to top the chart for nine straight weeks."}
{"summary":"The post is teasing Alfred Hitchcock: a 1964 photo shows the “Psycho” director wearing a Beatles-style mop-top wig, making him look a bit like Moe Howard."}

{"summary":"Galbani’s string-cheese packages show cartoon male characters on its full-fat varieties, but a female character on the reduced-fat cheese. A reader’s five-year-old daughter noticed and asked for the “girl cheese.”"}

{ "summary": "Google’s secret car company is called Google Auto LLC, a subsidiary registered in 2011 to legally operate its self-driving car project. It is listed as the manufacturer of Google’s 23 self-driving Lexus vehicles." }

{"summary":"Bill Carter, The New York Times’ veteran television reporter and author of The Late Shift, is taking the paper’s voluntary buyout after more than 25 years. He says the generous severance and economic pressures drove his decision; he has another book about late-night TV under contract and is seeking a new job."}

{ "summary": "The post teases the author’s defense of social-media-promoted, home-based businesses: she says many are legitimate multi-level marketing (MLM) businesses, not illegal pyramid schemes, and can help mothers earn money and gain flexibility. She urges readers to consider the work involved and support small-business owners." }

{ "summary": "The article compares currencies using prices for lattes, pizza, Hooters chicken wings and Nobu’s black cod, rather than just Big Macs. These food indexes suggest the dollar is overvalued against the yen and pound, London is especially expensive, and the euro is undervalued against pizza prices in Frankfurt." }

{"summary":"You generally do not need to fast before a cholesterol test: eating has little effect on total, HDL or LDL cholesterol results. Fasting can give a more accurate triglyceride reading, but many experts say nonfasting tests are sufficient for routine assessment and make testing easier."}

{ "summary": "GrubHub found that Syracuse University students ordered more late-night food than students at any other college surveyed. One in four Syracuse orders was placed between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m." }

{ "summary": "Turing Robotic Industries unveiled the Turing Phone Cadenza, a concept smartphone expected to launch the following year. The post is teasing its headline specs: 12GB of RAM and 1TB of built-in storage, expandable by up to 500GB, alongside features such as two Snapdragon 830 processors and a 60MP rear camera." }

{"summary":"A Comic-Con blooper reel from Orphan Black shows Tatiana Maslany, playing Cosima, telling someone on the phone that they need to talk to Cosima—an easy-to-make slip when she regularly plays several different clones."}

{"summary":"The “orphan cats” were actually three baby genets, rescued after their mother was driven away in South Africa. At the wildlife orphanage, a dog named Candy unexpectedly began producing milk and adopted them; two grew strong enough to return to the wild, while the third stayed at the center."}

{"summary":"M&M’s Mega, debuting in May 2014 in original and peanut varieties, is a new candy with three times more chocolate than regular M&M’s. Small milk-chocolate bags will cost $1.49, while medium bags of milk or peanut chocolate candies will cost $3.29."}

{ "summary": "The post teases 10 low-effort ways to stay healthy in 2017: drink less juice and one glass of warm water, improve your posture and breathing, garden, stretch or move for 10 minutes, relax in a bath, walk in a park, sneeze instead of holding it in, and spend less time reading depressing tweets." }

{"summary":"Nintendo’s $60 NES Classic Edition comes with 30 games, but its lineup can’t be expanded: the console has no internet connection or external-storage support, and the cartridge slot is decorative. It’s a standalone nostalgia device, not a platform for adding games."}

{"summary":"A Lovehoney survey of 4,400 customers found sex lasted an average of 19 minutes, including about 10 minutes of foreplay. Respondents said couples had a quickie 21% of the time, though the results may not represent everyone."}

{ "summary": "The USDA approved four Chinese poultry processors to export cooked meat from U.S.-raised birds to America, prompting concerns this could eventually include chicken raised and slaughtered in China. Because cooked poultry won’t require origin labels or on-site USDA supervision, shoppers may not know whether frozen chicken nuggets were processed in China." }

{"summary":"Alison Pill said her accidental topless photo tweet happened because she didn’t realize her new BlackBerry had a touchscreen while replying on Twitter. She called the mistake dumb and hideously embarrassing, and said the photo—a topless selfie taken in bed—left her feeling awkward meeting new people."}

{ "summary": "Pouring milk into Coca-Cola makes the drink turn clearer as curdled milk forms solid chunks that settle at the bottom, a reaction attributed to Coke’s phosphoric acid. The article also notes research linking frequent cola consumption with lower bone density, though the cause and health effects need further study." }

{ "summary": "Labrador retrievers were America’s most popular dog breed in 2016, topping the American Kennel Club rankings for a record 26th consecutive year. German shepherds and golden retrievers followed; Rottweilers rose to eighth, their best ranking in nearly 20 years." }

{ "summary": "After someone burned student Ben Schofield’s American flag in the parking lot at Wasatch High School in Heber City, Utah, classmates rushed to put out the fire. The next day, several dozen students rallied in red, white, and blue to condemn the vandalism and show support for the flag; Ben returned to school with another flag flying from his truck." }

{"summary":"At his sister Anelle’s high school graduation, Anthony dressed in a cap and gown and sat with the family in their prominent box seats, making her struggle not to laugh onstage. Many attendees recognized him as a popular graduate from the previous year; others assumed he was a student administration wouldn’t let walk."}

{"summary":"A man named Michel Bechard stripped naked in front of a White House security gate on Friday. When Secret Service officers tried to subdue him, he assaulted an officer and was taken into custody."}

{ "summary": "Madden NFL 2016’s Super Bowl 50 simulation predicts the Carolina Panthers will beat the Denver Broncos 24–20, with Cam Newton named MVP. The game-controlled teams were simulated once on the hardest difficulty." }

{ "summary": "The FBI arrested a man suspected of spraying a mixture of hand cleaner, water, and Tomcat mouse poison onto self-serve food and produce at grocery stores in Michigan, including Whole Foods and Meijer. No illnesses were reported, and the suspect’s motive was unknown." }

{"summary":"Researchers identified Tamu Massif, a long-extinct volcano hidden beneath the Pacific Ocean, as Earth’s largest. About 400 miles wide and 2.5 miles tall, it lies underwater on Shatsky Rise and is even larger than Hawaii’s Mauna Loa."}

{"summary":"Texas voters rejected Mary Lou Bruner, a conspiracy-minded candidate for the State Board of Education, defeating her with a wide margin in favor of Kevin M. Ellis. Bruner had claimed, among other things, that Noah brought baby dinosaurs on the ark and that President Obama was a former drug-addled gay prostitute."}

{ "summary": "The post is teasing bay leaves as a natural cockroach repellent. The article recommends placing dried, crushed bay leaves—especially in corners and near food areas—to make their scent unpleasant to cockroaches, though it provides no evidence that this will eliminate an infestation." }

{ "summary": "On Sunday, Aug. 10, look for the year’s biggest supermoon after sunset: the full moon will coincide with its closest approach to Earth, making it appear up to 14 percent closer and 30 percent brighter than other full moons. The Perseid meteor shower may also be visible, and the article invites readers to share supermoon photos." }

{"summary":"Adrienne Maloof and Paul Nassif have resolved their divorce, announcing that they reached an agreement on all outstanding settlement issues and litigation. The former couple, who share three children, say they are moving forward separately and remain committed to co-parenting, with their children’s well-being as their priority."}

{"summary":"The small cylinder on a laptop charger cord is a ferrite bead. It suppresses high-frequency electromagnetic interference, preventing the cable from broadcasting or picking up unwanted radio signals that could disrupt nearby electronics."}

{"summary":"The post teases six tips for speeding up your metabolism. Fitness instructor Siphiwe Baleka’s advice is to track your sleep, keep consistent bed and wake times, stop using electronics about an hour before bed, keep devices out of the bedroom, use the bed only for sleep or sex, and wind down with chamomile tea or a book."}

{"summary":"Cats purr for more than just happiness: scientists suggest purring may soothe stress and support bone and muscle repair, while also communicating hunger or serving as an appeasing signal. The post is teasing that a purr doesn’t necessarily mean a cat is content—and its exact purpose remains uncertain."}

{"summary":"The post teases ten under-the-radar pop songs released in March: The Drums’ “Blood Under My Belt,” Offaiah’s “Run,” Computer Games’ “Every Single Night,” Nelly Furtado’s “Phoenix,” Aminé’s “REDMERCEDES,” Maddie Ross’ “You’re Still My Sugar,” B.O.Y.’s “Winning,” Louis the Child and Ashe’s “World on Fire,” Steps’ “Scared of the Dark,” and TYSM’s “Wraith.”"}

{ "summary": "As Arctic sea ice disappears, polar bears have more trouble hunting seals and finding food. The article says this is contributing to more cannibalism: desperate adult males are hunting younger bears, including cubs." }

{"summary":"A preliminary study of nearly 26,000 men found that Viagra (sildenafil) use was associated with a higher risk of melanoma, a dangerous form of skin cancer. The researchers say it’s too soon to change prescriptions and that the link needs further investigation."}

{"summary":"Tesla’s “Part Deux” master plan proposed expanding its lineup with a compact SUV and an electric pickup, alongside a heavy-duty Semi and high-capacity urban transport. The plan also called for more efficient carmaking to boost production and advance the company’s sustainability goals."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing a roundup of 23 products for people who want to be left alone: anti-small-talk clothes and accessories, cozy solo comforts, and items that celebrate solitude, from a “don’t talk to me” scarf to an antisocial plant mug."}

{"summary":"Breaking Bad is promoting its final eight episodes in Los Angeles with suggestive billboards as it campaigns for Emmy awards. That’s why you’ll be seeing more Walter White: the show is seeking awards-season votes from TV Academy members."}

{"summary":"Pokémon CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara says Pokémon will support Nintendo’s NX and describes it as changing the boundary between home consoles and handhelds. His comments reinforce speculation that the NX will be a hybrid device, possibly a portable console with detachable controllers, though Nintendo has not confirmed its design."}

{ "summary": "Houston is projected to pass Chicago and become the third-largest U.S. city within eight to 10 years, as its population grows while Chicago’s declines. The article attributes Houston’s growth to jobs, migration, and its energy-based economy." }

{ "summary": "Studies found that women rated men described as good storytellers more attractive as long-term partners and perceived them as higher status; men’s attraction to women was unaffected by storytelling ability. Researchers suggest storytelling may signal influence or social status, though more research is needed." }
{"summary":"“Orange Is the New Black” Season 2 premieres on Netflix on June 6. Laura Prepon will return as Alex for at least four episodes, and Lori Petty is joining the cast."}

{"summary":"The Golden State Warriors are No. 1 in the NBA Power Rankings for the fourth straight week, despite the Memphis Grizzlies’ league-best 15 wins and just two losses. Memphis is a close contender, but Golden State’s nine-game winning streak keeps it on top."}

{"summary":"The overlooked workplace wellness issue is menopause: symptoms such as hot flashes, insomnia, and concentration problems can be worsened by stressful or uncomfortable working conditions. European guidelines urge employers to foster supportive policies and consider accommodations such as cooler spaces, flexible schedules, stress reduction, and easier access to bathrooms."}

{"summary":"Robert Schwentke has been chosen to direct Insurgent, the sequel to Divergent, replacing Neil Burger, who could not return because of the tight production schedule. Schwentke previously directed Summit’s Red; Insurgent is scheduled for release on March 20, 2015."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing the article’s recommended morning habit: meditate first thing after waking. The article describes a simple one-minute daily meditation, saying meditation can help improve focus, reduce stress, and support health."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing a leather jacket as the one item every man should have in his closet. It can work with outfits from casual jeans to dress pants, and buyers should consider the style, price, and real or faux leather; the article warns against leather blazers."}

{"summary":"Prince George wears shorts because it follows an old British upper-class custom: young boys traditionally wore breeches (shorts), while trousers were associated with men. Etiquette expert William Hanson says the royal family continues the tradition, which dates back centuries and also signals social class."}
{"summary":"Dino Morea’s doppelganger is American actor Scott Foley, who plays Jake in the TV series *Scandal*. The article says the two look strikingly alike."}

{"summary":"The post teases a picture gallery featuring shortlisted photographs from the Sony World Photography Awards. The selection ranges from Mount Fuji during a marathon and beachgoers in Italy to a panda at a reserve, religious ceremonies, portraits, and scenes of city life; the winner was due to be announced on 20 April."}

{"summary":"Niantic plans to introduce ads in Pokémon Go through “sponsored locations”: businesses can pay to appear on the game’s virtual map, encouraging players to visit their stores. The post is teasing this new advertising feature, which could drive real-world foot traffic."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing how to tell whether people actually read your content—and how to make it more readable. Readers often skim in an F-pattern, few reach the end, and social shares don’t prove readership; use compelling sentences, put key information first, add images and scannable formatting, and optimize for mobile and other reading contexts."}

{ "summary": "A Sacred Heart University student, Nikki Yovino, was charged with falsely reporting that two football players raped her; police say she recanted and admitted making up the allegation to gain sympathy from another student she hoped to date. The players had been removed from the team, lost scholarships, and been expelled after her accusation." }

{"summary":"An internally flawless, emerald-cut 100-carat colorless diamond sold for $22.1 million at Sotheby’s in New York after less than three minutes of bidding. The anonymous buyer bid by phone; the sale set a record for the most expensive colorless diamond auctioned in New York."}

{"summary":"Airlines can deny you boarding or remove you because a flight is overbooked, a plane change or weight limit reduces available seats, crew members need transportation, or you violate airline rules—for example, by refusing to show ID or behaving abusively. If a flight is too full, airlines must first seek volunteers; involuntarily bumped passengers may be entitled to compensation if their arrival is delayed by more than an hour."}

{"summary":"An hour-long bath at 40°C may burn around 126 calories—roughly as much as a 20–30-minute brisk walk—and may help lower blood sugar, according to research from Loughborough University. The post is teasing that a hot bath can burn that many calories."}

{ "summary": "Former congressman Tom Perriello unexpectedly entered Virginia’s Democratic primary for governor, challenging the party’s favored candidate, Lt. Gov. Ralph Northam. The race may echo the 2016 divide between establishment Democrats and insurgent challengers, while Republicans also face a contested nomination." }

{ "summary": "The article says a school sent home a form for parents to request that their child be excused from reciting the Pledge of Allegiance. It claims a mother responded angrily, but the text doesn’t say what she wrote or did—the teased response is only referenced as being in an accompanying photo." }

{"summary":"Snickle Fritz, a giant dog rescued as a puppy, gets so excited when he visits the grandma who lives next door that he jumps on her. What he does next is shower her with kisses and enjoy belly scratches—she happily welcomes his affection."}

{"summary":"Bronte Leighton-Dore is donating an egg to help her gay brother Samuel and his partner, Bradley Tennant, have a child genetically related to both men. Bradley’s sperm will fertilize the egg, and a surrogate will carry the baby; Bronte says she is hugely proud to help."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing cow’s milk, especially pasteurized milk. The article claims pasteurization destroys enzymes needed to absorb calcium and phosphorus, and points to high osteoporosis rates in countries with heavy dairy consumption; it offers these claims as evidence that milk may harm bones, though the excerpt does not establish that milk causes osteoporosis."}

{"summary":"Listeria can contaminate raw vegetables through contact with soil or animal manure, then enter food-processing facilities and persist for years on equipment—especially in cold, damp conditions where it can grow. The article was prompted by a recall of Country Fresh precut onions, mushrooms and peppers after a product tested positive; no illnesses had been reported."}

{"summary":"Former Minneapolis Mayor R.T. Rybak suffered a massive heart attack while cross-country skiing, but tweeted that he was in good spirits. His poem joked, “My cardiac surprise/Gave me quite a start/But it proves this politician/Has a great big heart.”"}

{"summary":"After overhearing two women make racist remarks about Aboriginal people at a Perth cafe, Jarred Walls responded by sending them a pot of tea with a note: “Compliments of the 2 aboriginals sitting next to you.” He said he chose a quiet gesture over an angry confrontation in the hope it would make them think about what they’d said."}

{"summary":"Kelly Clarkson said on The Tonight Show that she and husband Brandon Blackstock are trying hard to conceive, joking, “We’re trying, trying, trying … like rabbits!” She said she’s eager to have children and now wants as many as five."}

{"summary":"After Slate editor Gabriel Roth mocked Merriam-Webster as a permissive “chill parent” for saying “mad” can mean “angry,” the dictionary replied, “No one cares how you feel.” The witty retort went viral; Merriam-Webster said the banter was meant in good fun and explained that dictionaries record how people actually use language."}

{"summary":"Artist Hanny Ahern’s project, *When I Think About You I Text Myself*, gives people a way to resist sending an impulsive message to an ex or someone else: text their thoughts to an anonymous hotline, which sends them back at intervals of three, six, nine and 12 months. The delayed replies let users revisit their feelings with perspective, rather than waking up to regret."}

{"summary":"Salesforce recruiting chief Ana Recio says she asks every job candidate: “What is your favorite pump up song, and why?” She uses the lighthearted icebreaker to learn about candidates’ personalities and assess their potential fit with the company culture; there’s no right or wrong answer."}

{"summary":"Eurostat data show that nearly 80% of European children were learning a second language in 2014, while the UK introduced compulsory language teaching in primary schools only in 2014, after most British pupils had started in secondary school. The post’s map highlights this early-start gap, though it has no UK data; Britain also ranks low for learning several languages, including 16th for German."}

{"summary":"A sound mistaken for gunfire triggered a lockdown at Valley Forge Military Academy and nearby universities, but police found no weapons and no one was hurt. Officials said the noise was most likely bubble wrap being popped."}

{"summary":"A Michigan mother thought her three-year-old daughter standing on a toilet was being mischievous, but the child was practising how to hide in a bathroom during a preschool lockdown drill for a gun attack. Shaken by the realization, the mother used the photo to call for action on gun violence, including stronger background checks and safer-gun measures."}

{"summary":"Danny Green says he doesn’t know whether Tim Duncan or Manu Ginobili will return or retire; neither veteran has revealed a decision. Duncan’s future remains the Spurs’ biggest question after their second-round playoff exit."}

{"summary":"Missing weekday gym sessions isn’t necessarily a problem: a study found that exercising just one or two days a week was linked to a lower risk of death than doing no exercise. Weekend warriors who met activity guidelines had lower risks of death overall, from cardiovascular disease, and from cancer, though the study relied on self-reported activity."}

{"summary":"The post’s “Loved and loathed” tease refers to Yogi Adityanath, the saffron-robed Hindu priest and controversial BJP politician appointed chief minister of Uttar Pradesh. He is revered by supporters in Gorakhpur but condemned by critics for anti-Muslim rhetoric and divisive politics; his leadership will be judged by whether he governs inclusively and reins in hard-line supporters."}

{"summary":"Michael Easton was set to return to General Hospital on March 18, 2016, in a new role—not as Dr. Silas Clay, who had been killed off. The article says the character’s identity and details were still undisclosed; rumors he might be a “nice” Cassadine were reportedly false."}

{ "summary": "Couples often wait years to seek marriage therapy, but by then one or both partners may have given up. Therapists recommend getting help early—or even before engagement—to address differences, prevent resentment and defensiveness, and learn how to stay connected through recurring problems and future crises." }

{"summary":"The article ranks golf’s 30 highest career earners, with Tiger Woods at No. 1 on $122.5 million, followed by Phil Mickelson ($94.6 million) and Vijay Singh ($75.9 million). The list spans current and past stars and combines PGA Tour and European Tour prize money, counting majors and WGC events only once."}
{"summary":"The post teases blue as the ultimate color for relaxation. The article says blue can promote peace and calm, and offers soothing blue scenes as a way to ease stress."}

{ "summary": "Inspired by her professor’s openness about mental illness, Miles got an ambigram tattoo that reads “I’m fine” from one angle and “save me” from another, symbolizing hidden struggles with depression. She shared its meaning in a Facebook post that went viral and now speaks up for people living with mental illness." }

{"summary":"The article’s seven suggestions are to practice a daily affirmation, focus on how you feel rather than dieting, follow people online who better represent you, find movement you enjoy, stop criticizing your body, enjoy food without using it to change your body, and unfollow or spend less time with social-media accounts that make you feel worse."}

{ "summary": "The post is teasing San Bernardino as California’s most dangerous city, according to a report that combines crime with factors such as poverty, unemployment, police staffing and graduation rates. It didn’t have the state’s highest rate of serious violent crime—Oakland and Stockton ranked worse—but came out on top when all the factors were considered." }

{ "summary": "Apple is reportedly set to unveil its new iPhones on September 9, though the company has not officially announced the event. The phones are expected to feature Force Touch, a better camera, and a more powerful wireless chip; new iPads and an Apple TV may also be announced." }

{"summary":"Shah Rukh Khan said Raees was not released alongside Salman Khan’s Sultan because both needed a wide theatrical release—there weren’t enough screens for two big films—and Raees still needed some shooting.
